title: Wishes
alt: Sketch: a dandelion's seeds blow away on a breath of wind and rise into a darkening sky, where each seed turns into a star; one seed stays on the stem.

title: Doorframe
line: The marks climbed until they stopped. Then someone small stood against the door.
alt: Sketch: pencil marks with names and dates climb a sunlit door frame year by year, then stop; a new mark in red appears at the very bottom.

title: Paper Boat
line: Go on. The water knows the way.
alt: Sketch: a sheet of paper folds itself into a paper boat, settles on still water at dawn and drifts away towards the horizon until it is a speck.

title: The Red Thread
line: It may tangle. It may stretch. It does not break.
alt: Sketch: a red thread runs from the window of one house on a hill, tangles into a knot in the sky, reaches a house on a far hill, then smooths into a gentle line as both windows light.

title: Every Spring
line: It lets go of everything, every year, and begins again.
alt: Sketch: a tree grows branch by branch from a seed, then goes through a year: pink blossom, green leaves, orange leaves falling, snow, and blossom again.

title: The Lighthouse
line: It cannot stop the storm. It keeps the light turning.
alt: Sketch: a lighthouse on a rock in a rainy night storm flickers on, and its yellow beam turns steadily while waves break against the rock.

title: Kintsugi
line: Where it broke is where the gold is.
alt: Sketch: a green glazed bowl breaks into three pieces that drift apart, come back together, and are mended with lines of gold along the cracks.

title: Two Cups
alt: Sketch: two teacups on saucers in morning window light; both steam at first, then only one does.

title: 52 Hertz
line: It sings at a pitch no other whale can hear. It sings anyway.
alt: Sketch: a whale glides alone in deep blue water and sends out rings of song that spread across the empty ocean and fade.

title: Small Light
line: The dark is very large. The flame does not know that.
alt: Sketch: in darkness a small flame nearly goes out, then catches, and its warm light reveals a candle on a table.
